headline: "Borrowed 1 Million Won, Can't Even Repay 50,000 Won Monthly": Delinquency Rate of 'Preventive Loans' Against Illegal Lending Exceeds 40% [Money Something]
summary: The delinquency rate on preventive loans meant to keep low-credit borrowers away from illegal lending exceeded 40% in about three and a half years. Borrowers often cannot repay even 50,000 won monthly, according to the report.
why: Government-backed lending programs for financially vulnerable borrowers affect credit quality and the policy costs of consumer finance in South Korea.
